plugins.name: ifg
plugins.description: Official tax texts at the right date, with applicability status, versions and a clickable official link: France and its neighbours (Luxembourg, Switzerland, Belgium, Germany, Monaco, Andorra, Italy), tax treaties, the EU and the OECD. Gaps are reported explicitly, never invented.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Connect the IFG tax sources MCP server (sign-in with an IFG account) and check that it works.
skills.description_zh: 使用 IFG 账号登录连接税务资料 MCP 服务，并检查连接是否正常。

skills.name: tax-research
skills.description: Research tax law with IFG official sources — find the right text, read it at the date of the tax event, and cite its official link. Use for any question on French, Luxembourg, Swiss, Belgian, German, Monegasque, Andorran or Italian tax law, tax treaties, EU tax law or OECD guidance.
skills.description_zh: 依据 IFG 官方资料研究法国、卢森堡、瑞士、比利时、德国、摩纳哥、安道尔、意大利税法，以及税收协定、欧盟税法和 OECD 指引，查找税务事件发生时适用文本并引用官方链接。
